title: Juice N Power Bar Salts Strawberry Raspberry Cherry 10ml E-Liquid
description: Strawberry Raspberry Cherry from the JNP Bar Salts collection presents a complex, multi-dimensional, and intensely fruity medley. The soft, familiar sweetness of Strawberry seamlessly blends into the bright, sharp bite of fresh Raspberry. To complete the trio, a robust note of dark Cherry grounds the profile, providing a deeply satisfying and continuously vibrant red berry experience. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, this premium nicotine salt formulation ensures rapid nicotine relief and a smooth, comfortable throat sensation. The balanced 50VG/50PG ratio provides an ideal combination of clear, intense flavour and discreet vapour production. These extra-concentrated e-liquids are designed specifically to perform reliably with low-wattage mouth-to-lung hardware, including refillable pod vape kits and classic starter vape kits. Formulated by the UK brand Juice N Power, the JNP Bar Salts collection takes inspiration from popular bar-style blends to deliver intense, long-lasting flavour in a versatile 10ml format. Offering a comprehensive range of fruit, soda, and confectionery profiles alongside unique mixes, there is a dependable option for every preference. Beyond the vibrant red fruit layers of Strawberry Raspberry Cherry, vapers can explore other compelling profiles such as the cool Pineapple Ice or the sophisticated Mr. Blue.
